description: This file declares the InstanceManager class for managing Android virtual device (AVD) instances, including creating, updating, removing groups, acquiring locks, and issuing commands within the Cuttlefish project.
external_methods: Result<void> IssueStopCommand(const CommandRequest&, const std::string&, LocalInstanceGroup&)

classes.name: InstanceManager
classes.description: Class responsible for managing Android virtual device instances, including group creation, removal, lock acquisition, and command issuance.

methods.name: HasInstanceGroups
methods.description: Checks whether there are any existing instance groups.

methods.name: CreateInstanceGroup
methods.description: Creates a new instance group based on provided group information.

methods.name: UpdateInstanceGroup
methods.description: Updates an existing instance group with the provided data.

methods.name: RemoveInstanceGroupByHome
methods.description: Removes an instance group identified by its home directory.

methods.name: CvdClear
methods.description: Clears the CVD state as per the command request.

methods.name: TryAcquireLock
methods.description: Attempts to acquire a lock on a specified instance by its number.

methods.name: FindGroups
methods.description: Finds multiple instance groups matching the specified filter.

methods.name: FindGroup
methods.description: Finds a single instance group matching the specified filter.

methods.name: FindInstanceWithGroup
methods.description: Finds an instance along with its group matching the provided filter.

methods.name: SetAcloudTranslatorOptout
methods.description: Sets the opt-out status for Acloud translator.

methods.name: GetAcloudTranslatorOptout
methods.description: Retrieves the current opt-out status for Acloud translator.

methods.name: IssueStopCommand
methods.description: Issues a stop command for a given instance group.
